title: Services Mega Dropdown in Navigation Bar
desc: Designed and implemented a responsive mega dropdown in navbar grouping all 15 services into categories with icons, subtext, and smooth hover transitions, while preserving direct navigation to the main services hub.

title: Centralized Services Data Architecture
desc: Created includes/data/services-data.php storing structured data for 15 services, including SEO tags, deliverables, tech stacks, processes, and FAQs to power the service catalog and individual detail pages.

title: Dedicated SEO Service Detail Pages
desc: Created 15 standalone service pages inside the services/ directory with unique meta titles, descriptions, breadcrumbs, JSON-LD schema (Service, FAQPage), and interactive UI sections for high SEO ranking.

title: FontAwesome Local Assets and CSP Header Fix
desc: Resolved missing icons on production by downloading FontAwesome 6 locally to assets/webfonts and updating the .htaccess Content Security Policy (CSP) header to whitelist style and font sources.

title: Apache Routing and Clean URL Configuration
desc: Configured .htaccess rewrite rules and router.php for clean URLs (/services/{slug}), prevented Apache mod_dir conflicts on the services directory, and added 301 redirects for legacy routes.

title: Directory Structure and Index File Cleanup
desc: Enforced single index.php policy by removing services/index.php, deleted the temporary scratch directory, and restored root services.php as the standalone services hub.

title: Query Parameter Cleanup Across Website
desc: Replaced all query parameter URLs (contact?service=...) with clean /contact links across service pages, project details, and tabs, adding automated 301 parameter stripping in contact.php.

title: Removal of Deprecated service-details.php
desc: Permanently deleted obsolete service-details.php after fully transitioning all 15 services to dedicated, SEO-optimized individual files with clean routing.

title: Services Tabbed Section and CTA Refactoring
desc: Updated includes/sections/services-tabbed.php to link directly to new individual service pages and replaced parameter-based inquiry buttons with clean contact navigation.

title: Persistent Profile Picture Database Storage Fix
desc: Resolved avatar loss after logout by ensuring user profile pictures are permanently persisted in the database and properly reloaded during authentication across sessions.

title: Notification Bell Direct Chat Navigation
desc: Enabled deep-linking on header notification items, allowing users to click any incoming message alert to navigate directly into the relevant teammate or group chat.

title: Interactive Profile Picture Cropping Tool
desc: Added a WhatsApp-style modal allowing users to zoom, drag, and crop their profile photo to a perfect circular aspect ratio prior to saving.

title: Fullscreen Profile Photo Lightbox Viewer
desc: Implemented a WhatsApp-style lightbox modal enabling users to view full-resolution, enlarged profile pictures by clicking any user avatar in the interface.

title: Chat Header Avatar and Status Display Fix
desc: Fixed the conversation header bar to consistently display the active recipient's avatar photo, online status, and role metadata.

title: Cloud Storage Audio Attachment Support
desc: Extended DigitalOcean Spaces storage services and backend upload routes to support multipart audio uploads for chat voice notes.

title: WhatsApp-Style Voice Note Audio Recorder
desc: Built an in-chat voice recorder using the MediaRecorder API featuring a live recording timer, recording wave indicator, and quick cancel/send controls.

title: In-Bubble Voice Note Audio Player
desc: Created a custom inline audio player inside chat bubbles featuring play/pause controls, seekable progress bar, and duration tracking.

title: Photo-Only Chat Image Attachment Feature
desc: Added photo-sharing functionality strictly restricted to image formats, complete with pre-send thumbnail previews, optional captions, and lightbox viewing.

title: Message Bubble UI Cleanup and Text Stripping
desc: Removed delete buttons from chat bubbles and eliminated auto-generated 'Attachment:' labels and filenames beneath voice notes and photos.

title: Group Creation Teammate Search Filter
desc: Introduced a real-time search input in the Create Group modal to swiftly filter and select colleagues by name, role, or email address.

title: Searchable Teammate List for Lead Discussions
desc: Replaced the static dropdown in the Lead Discussion setup with an interactive, searchable teammate list with avatars and role badges.

title: Search Input Icon and Placeholder Spacing Polish
desc: Fixed CSS specificity issues across all search bars, adding 44px padding to guarantee clean spacing between the search icon and placeholder text.

title: Production Build and Integration Verification
desc: Successfully built and verified all frontend Vite assets and backend TypeScript services, confirming zero regressions or runtime errors.
